probes.purpose: PAT_VISIT 近窗 VISIT_ID 单列组内患者数（单列连接跨患者串号分母）
probes.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT PATIENT_ID, VISIT_ID FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT WHERE DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-09-01' AND DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE'2026-09-21'), g AS (SELECT VISIT_ID k, COUNT(*) n FROM pv GROUP BY VISIT_ID) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pv) pv_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g) visit_id_groups, (SELECT NVL(MAX(n),0) FROM g) max_patients_per_visit_id, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM g) dup_visit_ids FROM dual

probes.purpose: 住院万能键唯一性 + 同患者多次住院占比（PATIENT_ID 单列连接缺 VISIT_ID 的放大分母）
probes.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT PATIENT_ID, VISIT_ID FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT WHERE DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-09-01' AND DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE'2026-09-21'), c AS (SELECT PATIENT_ID, COUNT(*) n FROM pv GROUP BY PATIENT_ID) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pv) pv_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT PATIENT_ID, VISIT_ID FROM pv GROUP BY PATIENT_ID, VISIT_ID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)) dup_visit_keys, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c) patients, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM c) multi_visit_patients, (SELECT NVL(MAX(n),0) FROM c) max_visits_per_patient FROM dual

probes.purpose: 门诊收据键：OUTP_BILL_ITEMS/OUTP_ORDER_DESC 近窗 RCPT_NO 单列与三列组重复

probes.purpose: DEPT_DICT DEPT_CODE 重复与 STOP_FLAG 分布（停用/重用）

probes.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT VISIT_DATE, VISIT_NO FROM HIS.OUTP_MR_DIAG_DESC WHERE VISIT_DATE >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND VISIT_DATE < DATE'2026-09-21'), g AS (SELECT VISIT_NO, COUNT(*) n FROM d GROUP BY VISIT_NO) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM d) rows_, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g) visit_no_groups, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM g) dup_visit_no FROM dual

probes.purpose: 住院费用守恒：visit 级 INP_BILL_DETAIL.COSTS 对 INP_SETTLE_MASTER.COSTS
probes.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT PATIENT_ID, VISIT_ID FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT WHERE DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE'2026-09-21' AND ROWNUM <= 200), b AS (SELECT ib.PATIENT_ID, ib.VISIT_ID, SUM(ib.COSTS) s FROM INPBILL.INP_BILL_DETAIL ib WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pv WHERE pv.PATIENT_ID = ib.PATIENT_ID AND pv.VISIT_ID = ib.VISIT_ID) GROUP BY ib.PATIENT_ID, ib.VISIT_ID), t AS (SELECT sm.PATIENT_ID, sm.VISIT_ID, SUM(sm.COSTS) s, COUNT(*) n FROM INPBILL.INP_SETTLE_MASTER sm WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pv WHERE pv.PATIENT_ID = sm.PATIENT_ID AND pv.VISIT_ID = sm.VISIT_ID) GROUP BY sm.PATIENT_ID, sm.VISIT_ID) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pv) visits, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b) with_bill, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t) with_settle, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b JOIN t ON b.PATIENT_ID = t.PATIENT_ID AND b.VISIT_ID = t.VISIT_ID WHERE ABS(NVL(b.s,0) - NVL(t.s,0)) < 0.01) matched_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE n > 1) multi_settle_visits FROM dual

probes.purpose: 门诊三口径金额对账：明细 SUM vs 收据 TOTAL_COSTS vs 支付净额
probes.sql: WITH k AS (SELECT DISTINCT RCPT_NO FROM OUTPBILL.OUTP_BILL_ITEMS WHERE VISIT_DATE >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND VISIT_DATE < DATE'2026-09-21' AND ROWNUM <= 300), b AS (SELECT RCPT_NO, SUM(CHARGES) s FROM OUTPBILL.OUTP_BILL_ITEMS WHERE RCPT_NO IN (SELECT RCPT_NO FROM k) GROUP BY RCPT_NO), r AS (SELECT RCPT_NO, TOTAL_COSTS FROM OUTPBILL.OUTP_RCPT_MASTER WHERE RCPT_NO IN (SELECT RCPT_NO FROM k)), p AS (SELECT RCPT_NO, SUM(NVL(PAYMENT_AMOUNT,0)) pay, SUM(NVL(REFUNDED_AMOUNT,0)) ref FROM OUTPBILL.OUTP_PAYMENTS_MONEY WHERE RCPT_NO IN (SELECT RCPT_NO FROM k) GROUP BY RCPT_NO) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM k) rcpts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b) with_items, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r) with_master, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p) with_pay, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b JOIN r ON b.RCPT_NO = r.RCPT_NO WHERE ABS(NVL(b.s,0) - NVL(r.TOTAL_COSTS,0)) < 0.01) items_eq_master, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b JOIN p ON b.RCPT_NO = p.RCPT_NO WHERE ABS(NVL(b.s,0) - (NVL(p.pay,0) - NVL(p.ref,0))) < 0.01) items_eq_net FROM dual

probes.purpose: 预交金三键唯一性：RCPT_NO / ADD 表三列（RCPT_NO+CHECK_NO+BANK_CODE）

probes.purpose: OPER_CODE 多义分流：ITEM_CLASS 分组的 OPER_CODE 非空/长格式/EXAM_NO 命中
probes.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT PATIENT_ID, VISIT_ID FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT WHERE DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE'2026-09-21' AND ROWNUM <= 200), ib AS (SELECT ITEM_CLASS, OPER_CODE FROM INPBILL.INP_BILL_DETAIL ibd WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pv WHERE pv.PATIENT_ID = ibd.PATIENT_ID AND pv.VISIT_ID = ibd.VISIT_ID)) SELECT ITEM_CLASS, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN OPER_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) oper_code_nonnull, SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(OPER_CODE) >= 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) len_ge8 FROM ib GROUP BY ITEM_CLASS

probes.purpose: INP_SETTLE_MASTER↔_YB 组合键覆盖与各自重复（草稿8 vs 草稿30）
probes.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT PATIENT_ID, VISIT_ID FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT WHERE DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE'2026-09-21' AND ROWNUM <= 200), a AS (SELECT sm.PATIENT_ID, sm.VISIT_ID, COUNT(*) n FROM INPBILL.INP_SETTLE_MASTER sm WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pv WHERE pv.PATIENT_ID = sm.PATIENT_ID AND pv.VISIT_ID = sm.VISIT_ID) GROUP BY sm.PATIENT_ID, sm.VISIT_ID), b AS (SELECT yb.PATIENT_ID, yb.VISIT_ID, COUNT(*) n FROM INPBILL.INP_SETTLE_MASTER_YB yb WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pv WHERE pv.PATIENT_ID = yb.PATIENT_ID AND pv.VISIT_ID = yb.VISIT_ID) GROUP BY yb.PATIENT_ID, yb.VISIT_ID) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a) settle_visits, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM a) settle_dup, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b) yb_visits, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM b) yb_dup, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a JOIN b ON a.PATIENT_ID = b.PATIENT_ID AND a.VISIT_ID = b.VISIT_ID) both FROM dual

probes.purpose: ID_NO 连接覆盖率（PPI：仅聚合零值回显）

probes.purpose: OPERATION 侧每 visit 手术条数分布（直连放大分子侧 A）

probes.purpose: ODS HIS.OPERATION_MASTER 每 visit 台次分布 + OPER_ID 非空 + 同日多台次
probes.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT PATIENT_ID, VISIT_ID FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT WHERE DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE'2026-09-21' AND ROWNUM <= 200), g AS (SELECT om.PATIENT_ID, om.VISIT_ID, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN om.OPER_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_op, COUNT(DISTINCT om.START_DATE_TIME) dts FROM HIS.OPERATION_MASTER om WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pv WHERE pv.PATIENT_ID = om.PATIENT_ID AND pv.VISIT_ID = om.VISIT_ID) GROUP BY om.PATIENT_ID, om.VISIT_ID) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pv) visits, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g) visits_with_om, (SELECT NVL(SUM(n),0) FROM g) om_rows, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM g) multi_om_visits, (SELECT NVL(MAX(n),0) FROM g) max_per_visit, (SELECT NVL(SUM(null_op),0) FROM g) oper_id_null, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN n > dts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM g) same_day_multi FROM dual

probes.purpose: DIAGNOSIS_TYPE 分布 + DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 覆盖（对照 confirmed 1/2/3/7/8）
probes.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT PATIENT_ID, VISIT_ID FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT WHERE DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE'2026-09-21' AND ROWNUM <= 200), d AS (SELECT dg.PATIENT_ID, dg.VISIT_ID, dg.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE tp, dg.DIAGNOSIS_NO no_ FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dg WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pv WHERE pv.PATIENT_ID = dg.PATIENT_ID AND pv.VISIT_ID = dg.VISIT_ID)) SELECT tp, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN no_ = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no1 FROM d GROUP BY tp

probes.purpose: 术式码孤儿率：OPERATION.OPERATION_CODE→OPERATION_DICT
probes.sql: WITH pv AS (SELECT PATIENT_ID, VISIT_ID FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT WHERE DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE'2026-09-21' AND ROWNUM <= 200), o AS (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE oc FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pv WHERE pv.PATIENT_ID = op.PATIENT_ID AND pv.VISIT_ID = op.VISIT_ID)) SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN oc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) code_null, SUM(CASE WHEN oc IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COMM.OPERATION_DICT od WHERE od.OPERATION_CODE = o.oc) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphans FROM o

probes.purpose: LAB_RESULT 大表约束：TEST_NO 限定下结果行/项目行与单列连接放大
probes.sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT TEST_NO FROM LAB.LAB_TEST_MASTER WHERE REQUESTED_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND REQUESTED_DATE_TIME < DATE'2026-09-21' AND ROWNUM <= 200), r AS (SELECT lr.TEST_NO, COUNT(*) n FROM LAB.LAB_RESULT lr WHERE lr.TEST_NO IN (SELECT TEST_NO FROM seed) GROUP BY lr.TEST_NO), i AS (SELECT li.TEST_NO, COUNT(*) n FROM LAB.LAB_TEST_ITEMS li WHERE li.TEST_NO IN (SELECT TEST_NO FROM seed) GROUP BY li.TEST_NO), j AS (SELECT NVL(r.n,0) rn, NVL(i.n,0) in_, r.TEST_NO FROM r LEFT JOIN i ON r.TEST_NO = i.TEST_NO) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seed) seed_tests, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r) tests_with_results, (SELECT NVL(SUM(n),0) FROM r) result_rows, (SELECT NVL(SUM(n),0) FROM i) item_rows, (SELECT NVL(SUM(rn),0) FROM j) join_left_rows, (SELECT NVL(SUM(rn * in_),0) FROM j) single_key_join_rows FROM dual

probes.purpose: 检查链 EXAM_NO 覆盖：ITEMS/REPORT 命中 + EXAM_PAT_MI 两列键覆盖

probes.purpose: 库存粒度样本：药码+规格 行数/库房数/批号数分布（PK 元数据活库复核）

probes.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT PRESC_DATE, PRESC_NO FROM PHARMACY.DRUG_PRESC_MASTER WHERE PRESC_DATE >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND PRESC_DATE < DATE'2026-09-21' AND ROWNUM <= 2000), g AS (SELECT PRESC_NO, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT PRESC_DATE) d FROM s GROUP BY PRESC_NO) SELECT COUNT(*) nos, SUM(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) reuse_nos, NVL(MAX(n),0) max_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN d>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cross_date_nos FROM g

probes.purpose: 检验批次↔申请单：TEST_NO 命中/重复 + PATIENT_ID 单列放大
probes.sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT TEST_NO FROM LAB.LAB_TEST_MASTER WHERE REQUESTED_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND REQUESTED_DATE_TIME < DATE'2026-09-21' AND ROWNUM <= 200), b AS (SELECT bm.TEST_NO, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT bm.PATIENT_ID) pts FROM LAB.LAB_TEST_BATCH_MASTER bm WHERE bm.TEST_NO IN (SELECT TEST_NO FROM seed) GROUP BY bm.TEST_NO) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seed) seed_tests, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b) matched, (SELECT NVL(MAX(n),0) FROM b) max_rows_per_test, (SELECT NVL(MAX(pts),0) FROM b) max_patients_per_test FROM dual

probes.purpose: ORDERS 四列键下游覆盖：EXECUTE_DETAILS/ANTI_DRUG/DISPENSE_REC 命中与一嘱多执行
probes.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT PATIENT_ID, VISIT_ID, ORDER_NO, ORDER_SUB_NO FROM ORDADM.ORDERS WHERE START_DATE_TIME >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND START_DATE_TIME < DATE'2026-09-21' AND ROWNUM <= 200), e AS (SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT x.PATIENT_ID || x.VISIT_ID || x.ORDER_NO || x.ORDER_SUB_NO) k FROM ORDADM.ORDERS_EXECUTE_DETAILS x WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID = x.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID = x.VISIT_ID AND o.ORDER_NO = x.ORDER_NO AND o.ORDER_SUB_NO = x.ORDER_SUB_NO)), a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM ORDADM.ORDERS_ANTI_DRUG x WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID = x.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID = x.VISIT_ID AND o.ORDER_NO = x.ORDER_NO AND o.ORDER_SUB_NO = x.ORDER_SUB_NO)), d AS (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM PHARMACY.DRUG_DISPENSE_REC x WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID = x.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID = x.VISIT_ID AND o.ORDER_NO = x.ORDER_NO AND o.ORDER_SUB_NO = x.ORDER_SUB_NO)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o) seed_orders, (SELECT NVL(n,0) FROM e) exec_rows, (SELECT NVL(k,0) FROM e) exec_distinct_keys, (SELECT NVL(n,0) FROM a) anti_rows, (SELECT NVL(n,0) FROM d) dispense_rows FROM dual

probes.purpose: 护理患者链：近窗 INPATIENTS.pat_index_no ↔ MCS_DOC_FORM.patient_uid 命中
probes.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT PAT_INDEX_NO FROM LUNA_MCS_SDSEY.INPATIENTS WHERE ADMISSION_TIME >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND ROWNUM <= 200), f AS (SELECT fm.PATIENT_UID, COUNT(*) n FROM LUNA_MCS_SDSEY.MCS_DOC_FORM fm WHERE fm.PATIENT_UID IN (SELECT PAT_INDEX_NO FROM p) GROUP BY fm.PATIENT_UID) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p) patients, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f) with_forms, (SELECT NVL(SUM(n),0) FROM f) form_rows, (SELECT NVL(MAX(n),0) FROM f) max_forms_per_patient FROM dual

probes.purpose: 表单-记录键 + 同患者同模板重复评估分布（样本 5000）
probes.sql: WITH fa AS (SELECT PATIENT_UID, TEMPLATE_CODE FROM LUNA_MCS_SDSEY.MCS_DOC_FORM WHERE CREATED_DATE >= DATE'2026-09-14' AND ROWNUM <= 5000), g AS (SELECT PATIENT_UID, TEMPLATE_CODE, COUNT(*) n FROM fa GROUP BY PATIENT_UID, TEMPLATE_CODE), fr AS (SELECT ID FROM LUNA_MCS_SDSEY.MCS_DOC_FORM WHERE ROWNUM <= 500), r AS (SELECT FORM_ID, COUNT(*) n FROM LUNA_MCS_SDSEY.MCS_DOC_FORM_RECORDS WHERE FORM_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM fr) GROUP BY FORM_ID) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g) patient_template_pairs, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM g) repeat_assess_pairs, (SELECT NVL(MAX(n),0) FROM g) max_assess, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fr) forms_sample, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r) with_records, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM r) dup_formid_records FROM dual
